Welcome to Our Wilderness Lodge Haven:
Your Gateway to the Kruger National Park
Situated a mere 30 minutes' drive from the world-renowned Kruger National Park, you will find Unyati Safari Lodge. Ideally located between Swaziland, Mozambique and the Kruger National Park, it is easily accessible, catering for both the individual traveller and groups. Unyati is the essence of an authentic safari stay, with free roaming antelope and other game on our private game reserve.
The Lodge
Where Nature Meets Comfort
Our 45 en-suite safari tents and 6 thatched chalets can accommodate a total of 108 guests. Relax around the pool or indulge in a sundowner while our attentive and friendly staff take care of all your needs. Dine the African way or experience a traditional boma evening around a crackling fire. A range of excursions and activities are also offered.

About | Unyati Safari Lodge
THE LODGE
The Lodge
Unyati Safari Lodge lies amongst an oasis of enormous Jackalberry and Marula trees with its lush green lawns and meticulously maintained gardens. The traditional thatched roof main building plays host to the lounge, dining room, curio shop and bar. Two spacious boma's for those dinners under the African stars. The swimming pool and pool bar is a popular place on those hot summer days.
Guests are accommodated in either comfortable chalets or safari tents. Accessibility to the lodge is simplified with less than 2km of well-maintained dirt road, suitable for coaches and regular motor vehicles.
Useful Information
Airports
Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport (KMIA), Nelspruit is our closest airport 94Km
OR Thambo International Airport 425Km
Skukuza (Kruger National Park) 103Km
Cellphone Reception
Cell phone reception can be enjoyed at the Lodge. Signal strength vary between the different networks.
Check-in / Check-out time
Check-in: 14H00 16H00
Check-out: 10H00
Children
Children of all ages are welcome. Children between the ages of 2 and 12 years of age sharing a room with two full-paying adults will be charged 50% of the per person sharing rate. Children over 12 years of age pay the full adult rate. Children in their own room pay standard adult rates.
Credit Cards
We accept Visa, MasterCard and American Express
Climate
Hot and humid, summer is known as the wet season, occurring from October through April. The dry and mild winter months, from May to September, are considered the dry season. It is necessary to pack warm clothing if visiting during winter, as early morning and evenings tend to be cold. During summertime, thunderstorms occur during most afternoons.
Directions
From Pretoria:
Take the N4 heading East toward Nelspuit (approx. 315km). When you reach Nelspruit continue on the N4 for 75km towards Malelane / Komatipoort as if you were heading towards Mozambique. Just before you reach the town of Hectorspruit you will turn right onto the Jeppes Reef Road, follow this road for 5 km, then turn left onto the Strydomblok Road, continue on this road for 10km where you will find Unyati Safari Lodge on your right-hand.
From Johannesburg (OR Thambo International Airport):
Take the R21 towards Johannesburg, then get onto the N12 to Emalahleni, which becomes the N4. Continue straight towards Nelspruit. Distance from OR Thambo to Nelspruit is approximately 325km. When you reach Nelspruit continue on the N4 for 75km towards Malelane / Komatipoort as if you were heading towards Mozambique. Just before you reach the town of Hectorspruit you will turn right onto the Jeppes Reef Road, follow this road for 5 km, then turn left onto the Strydomblok Road, continue on this road for 10km where you will find Unyati Safari Lodge on your right-hand.
From Nelspruit:
From Nelspruit take the N4 for 75km towards Malelane / Komatipoort as if you were heading towards Mozambique. Just before you reach the town of Hectorspruit you will turn right onto the Jeppes Reef Road, follow this road for 5 km, then turn left onto the Strydomblok Road, continue on this road for 10km where you will find Unyati Safari Lodge on your right-hand.

Accommodation | Unyati Safari Lodge
ACCOMMODATION
Accommodation
Our 45 en-suite safari tents and 6 thatched chalets can accommodate a total of 108 guests.
Relax around the pool or indulge in a sundowner while our attentive and friendly staff take care of all your needs.
Dine the African way or experience a traditional boma evening around a crackling fire.
A range of excursions and activities are also offered.
Chalets
3 thatched roof Family Chalets make provision to accommodate 2 adults and 2 children. Each of these air-conditioned family chalets has a main bedroom with a king-size bed and an open plan area with two single beds. Built in cupboards, a dressing table and an en-suite bathroom are all standard in the Family Chalets.
3 thatched roof Standard Chalets each offers the opportunity to have twin beds or one king-size bed depending on your personal preference. Air-conditioning, built in cupboards, a dressing table and an en-suite bathroom are all standard in the Standard Chalets.

Safari Tents
Rustic pathways lead you between our 45 Safari Tents under large Jackalberry, Marula and Tamboti trees. Purposely built on timber decking, each of the tents are 30sqm under canvas, furnished with extra-length twin beds which can be converted into one king-size bed, depending on your personal preference. Crisp white linen, complimentary guest amenities and 220-volt power are standard in each tent.
The Safari Tents all have built-in bathrooms with a shower and wash basin and hot and cold running water. Your very own verandah has two chairs waiting for you to sit back and enjoy the African sunset.
